scope: Fixed before conditional domain-guard implementation. 24 new formulations, 12 course questions and 12 out-of-course questions; four known regression controls. Topic families overlap historical training, so not independent-topic validation.
model_rule: Historical 37-label E5 logistic regression, C=10 balanced, seed0, default class boundary .5. May change only ordinary original whole-query scores in [.10,.20); structural exceptions/strong results/E5 fallback keep existing behavior. No tuning on this set.
